monitor.temporal_model: source_updated_at, event_start, event_end and last_detection are stored separately; display update age never uses a future event end

wildfire_discovery_extension.purpose: recover wildfires started 8-21 days ago when last detection remains within the standard 7-day freshness window

monitor.wildfire_identity_policy: distinct wildfire source IDs are published individually; proximity does not merge or cluster fires
monitor.storm_display_rule: CEMS activation OR GDACS Orange/Red OR populated GDACS TC footprint; EONET-only fallback uses populated 300 km center buffer
monitor.human_impact_progressive_disclosure: highlight actual human-impact variables primarily for Red/severe events and only when a reliable source provides them
monitor.wildfire_metric_alignment: Discovery uses GDACS event-list data; public wildfire headline burned area, last detection, duration and source-native population are aligned to one GDACS/GWIS episode.

event_footprints.source: GDACS mapped polygons for wildfire, cyclone, drought and flood when available
event_footprints.analysis_geometry: unsimplified transient geometry used by same-run exposure enrichment
event_footprints.wildfire_qc: exposure-grade admission requires GDACS/GWIS burned-area provenance, same-episode alignment, and a coarse mapped/source burned-area ratio between 0.5 and 2.0
event_footprints.flood_qc: select one center-aligned GDACS reported event/affected-area feature; retain it as context only and never infer inundation
event_footprints.no_polygon_behavior: do not display a footprint panel or polygon-derived exposure metric

asset_exposure.drought: mapped area; MODIS 2024 land/forest area and FAO CROPGRIDS 2020 crop physical area when prepared
asset_exposure.wildfire: MODIS 2024 forest area within mapped wildfire footprint when prepared
asset_exposure.flood_population: GHSL 2025 population inside the QC-passed GDACS reported flood event-area polygon; labelled potentially affected population, not confirmed impact
asset_exposure.flood_and_tc_gdp: GHSL 2025 population within country-split mapped footprint × World Bank WDI 2024 GDP per capita; exposure proxy only

climate_context.note: Recent IFS values are seven-day short-range model-forecast context, not observations or causal event attribution.

hazard_exposure.wildfire_rule: GDACS Orange/Red visible; Green requires burned area >= 10,000 ha AND population within 5 km > 10,000. GDACS/GWIS POP scalars are preferred; polygon × GHSL is fallback only.
hazard_exposure.storm_rule: GDACS advisory pop39/pop74/popstormsurge preferred; polygon × GHSL is fallback when structured source exposure is unavailable. Orange/Red remain visible.
hazard_exposure.interpretation: Exposure is not observed harm, casualties, displacement, crop loss or economic loss.
hazard_exposure.fallback_population_dataset: JRC GHSL GHS-WUP-POP R2025A, epoch 2025, used only for Climate Pulse population fallback calculations
hazard_exposure.authority_policy: source-first: GDACS/GWIS structured modelled exposure first; Climate Pulse-derived metrics only as fallback or clearly labelled supplemental context
hazard_exposure.drought_rule: Use GDACS/GDO agricultural drought risk/impact information when published. Do not infer actual crop loss or affected population; derived land/forest/crop overlap is supplemental spatial context.

terminology.exposed_population: people spatially inside a modelled hazard footprint or buffer
terminology.affected_population: use only when a source reports actual impacts
terminology.estimated_exposed_population: Climate Pulse-derived spatial estimate when the upstream equivalent is unavailable

hazard_exposure.wildfire_source_alignment: GDACS/GWIS current-episode headline metrics; event-list values are discovery metadata only.

wildfire_display_diagnostics.green_boundary_policy: inclusive at 10,000 people within 5 km to avoid source-rounding threshold flicker
wildfire_display_diagnostics.identity_policy: one eligible wildfire event per explicit source identity; no proximity clustering

asset_exposure.drought: mapped area; MODIS 2024 land/forest area and FAO CROPGRIDS 2020 crop physical area when prepared
asset_exposure.wildfire: MODIS 2024 forest area within mapped wildfire footprint when prepared
asset_exposure.flood_population: GHSL 2025 population inside the QC-passed GDACS reported flood event-area polygon; labelled potentially affected population, not confirmed impact
asset_exposure.flood_and_tc_gdp: GHSL 2025 population within country-split mapped footprint × World Bank WDI 2024 GDP per capita; exposure proxy only
